ideas.title: Following the Money in Education Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in education-related fraud cases, including the LAUSD AI project and Minnesota Somali fraud.
questions: How are funds being misused in education-related fraud cases?
What are the consequences of education fraud for students and taxpayers?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify potential perpetrators and understand the scope of education-related fraud. This investigation could lead to significant recoveries of misused funds and improved accountability in the education sector.
